sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:12

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:12:1
items.html: Something similar to this is also in particular, etc., and likewise, in this manner it was in the particular of the particular, etc., and likewise, in this manner, in the ten Sefirot included in each and every Sefira. After he explained the four worlds in general, that each higher one is more choice, he says that so it is in particular, that is, in the five particular Partzufim in each and every world, which stand one below the other and are called Atik, AA, AVI and ZON — for Atik was sorted from the choicest, and the one inferior to it for AA, etc. And in this manner in the particular of the particular; for in each Partzuf of these five particular Partzufim there are, in itself as well, five Partzufim one below the other, and in them too this rule applies, that each higher one was sorted from the more choice. And in this manner in the ten Sefirot that are included in each and every Sefira; for at the time of the coupling that is made by the upper light with the screen that is in the vessel of Malchut, the Sefirot were included one in the other (as written in the Inner Observation, Part 2; see there). And behold, in them too this rule holds precisely, that each higher one was sorted from the more choice vessels. And see in the book Beit Sha’ar LaKavanot (item 146), where it is explained how there come out of every coupling twenty-five Partzufim whose level is equal; and each higher one is emanated first.
